title: Structure and mechanical properties of ambient ductile TiZrNbHf refractory high-entropy alloy: A first principles and experimental study
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting of Ti, Zr, Nb and Hf elements with purity greater than 99.9% at 5×10⁻³ Pa vacuum with 6 remelts, followed by 80% cold rolling and annealing at 1000°C for 30 minutes in vacuum
